arcane_adaptation.name: Arcane Adaptation

originalObject.name: Arcane Adaptation
originalObject.description: Your magic bends to mirror what strikes you, letting you reshape your defenses after every reflected blow. Prestige lineage: Echomancer. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.effect: When you successfully reflect or copy a spell or supernatural ability, you gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest, you may treat a copied effect as if you had always known it for 2 rounds.
originalObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalObject.legacyEffect: When you successfully reflect or copy a spell or supernatural ability, you gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest, you may treat a copied effect as if you had always known it for 2 rounds.

arcane_adaptation.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
arcane_adaptation.completeOperativeProcedure: After an actual successful legal reflection or capture of a spell/supernatural effect through a separately owned source, gain resistance to the one real damage type expressed by its selected copied/reflected component until your next future regular end. NEW choose one observed type for a mixed packet; nondamaging effects grant no damage resistance. It begins after capture/redirect, does not retroactively mitigate earlier damage, and grants no copying permission by itself. Once SR/LR at that event, also mark the one legal captured profile as temporarily known through your second future regular start. During that interval you may activate that exact bounded profile using its actual action, RP, components, rank ceiling and concentration, even if its original one-use record was consumed; no other original spell/monster ability is learned. Each activation is a copy retaining the original no-proc/no-copy/resource flags and the shared one-copy-release/round cap below. Existing Mirrorsage records retain their actual release costs/caps and printed bounded profile. No restoration of archive slots or legacy boss power. Expiry removes permission but not legitimately established effects before their own deadlines.
arcane_adaptation.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
arcane_adaptation.sourceDecision: Adopt bounded witnessed-type resistance and temporary access to one supported paid copy profile; no Mirrorsage archive, rank ceiling or release allowance is duplicated.

eldritch_echo.name: Eldritch Echo

originalObject.name: Eldritch Echo
originalObject.description: Your patron's voice returns through you, repeating power that was never meant for mortal throats. Prestige lineage: Warlock. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.prerequisite: Forbidden Pact or spellcasting ability, level 3+
originalObject.effect: You gain Eldritch Blast as a known cantrip if you do not already have it; it scales with your level. Once per short rest, when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, you may echo a simplified version of that spell on your next turn (DM adjudicates equivalent level, usually half the original).
originalObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalObject.legacyEffect: You gain Eldritch Blast as a known cantrip if you do not already have it; it scales with your level. Once per short rest, when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, you may echo a simplified version of that spell on your next turn (DM adjudicates equivalent level, usually half the original).

eldritch_echo.printedPrerequisite: Forbidden Pact or spellcasting ability, level 3+
eldritch_echo.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
eldritch_echo.completeOperativeProcedure:
Require character 3 AND (Forbidden Pact OR actual spellcasting). Gain the exact NEW Eldritch Blast cantrip profile below once; duplicate grant through Forbidden Pact shares one identity. Once SR/LR when you actually perceive a creature within 60 ft/line of effect completing an eligible noncopyspell, use a Reaction to capture one matching bounded copy profile below. NEW the source may be ally or foe, but cannot be a resource/copy/production effect or protected boss/legendary ability. Record original rank and the profile’s half-rankq; it must fit your actual qualifying casting route’s learnable ceiling, with Forbidden Pact’s explicit rank 0 grant supplying no ranked ceiling by itself. On your next future regular turn use anAction, actualRPprice and V/S and any additional actual copied-profile component requirement to release that one profile; otherwise it expires at that turn’s end. It is a copied spell activation with actual Dissonance/Refrain/history and interruption at release, no new proc/capture. No free original full spell, copied casterstatistics or Warlockclass.
NEW classification reconciliation, FS-08: releasing this captured spell is a paid feat-copy cast, using the releaser’s specified ability/PB, actual components, current RP price, rank and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain. It is not a resource-free nonspell release. It grants no ordinary repertoire/class feature or further capture, echo, reflection, external feat amplification, class resource/proc or reward chain. The concrete copy profile and its independent component/range/target/deadline limits still apply. This is deliberately different from Echo Spell/Twin Cast secondary results and from an actual Mirrorsage class Echo Release.
eldritch_echo.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
eldritch_echo.sourceDecision: Adopt the separate feat-only CHA Eldritch Blast plus one bounded captured profile; release is an actual paid feat-copy cast, not an ordinary spell grant or free class Echo.

mimicry.name: Mimicry

originalObject.name: Mimicry
originalObject.description: See it once, steal its thunder—your mirror learns faster than pride allows. Prestige lineage: Echomancer. completed from the existing development record.)
originalObject.effect: When you witness a spell or monster ability used against you or within 30 feet, you can mimic a simplified version once before your next short rest. The mimicked effect lasts up to 2 rounds and is usually at half potency (DM adjudicates).
originalObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalObject.legacyEffect: When you witness a spell or monster ability used against you or within 30 feet, you can mimic a simplified version once before your next short rest. The mimicked effect lasts up to 2 rounds and is usually at half potency (DM adjudicates).

mimicry.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
mimicry.completeOperativeProcedure:
Once between beneficial SR/LR completions, when you perceive an eligible real spell/monster ability used against you at its lawful range OR resolving within 30 ft of you and line of effect, capture one matching finite copy profile below withoutAction. NEW one record and one release entitlement per rest epoch; cannot erase/replace to gain repeated uses. No copy from a copy, protectedunique/legendary/boss feature, classengine, resource/action/creation effect or an unobserved component. Actual targeted-at-you clause may exceed 30 ft only if you genuinely perceive the source and effect. The stored profile expires at the next beneficial SR/LR; release before then usesAction, V/S, actualRPprice and its actual qualifying casting ability/rank ceiling. Its numeric native ceiling is half the observed eligible component as detailed below and duration at most two future regular intervals; no original source stats/unboundedDirector invention. Successful capture alone is not a cast; release commits ordinary spell history/interruption and the one-copy-release/round allowance. Failed/countered release consumes record/use, and a later rest never refills a missing copy.
NEW classification reconciliation, FS-08: releasing this captured spell is a paid feat-copy cast, using the releaser’s specified ability/PB, actual components, current RP price, rank and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain. It is not a resource-free nonspell release. It grants no ordinary repertoire/class feature or further capture, echo, reflection, external feat amplification, class resource/proc or reward chain. The concrete copy profile and its independent component/range/target/deadline limits still apply. This is deliberately different from Echo Spell/Twin Cast secondary results and from an actual Mirrorsage class Echo Release.
mimicry.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
mimicry.sourceDecision: Adopt actual observed/targeted capture into a finite profile and paid feat-copy cast; preserve rank, RP, visibility and once-rest limits without copying class engines or unknown powers.

completeProfile.name: Eldritch Blast
completeProfile.castingAbility: CHA; both feat grants share this one source ability/identity, not two selectable histories.
completeProfile.effect: Make one spell attack for 1d10 force. Explicit total-character-level scaling supplies 2 beams at 5,3 at 11,4 at 17; declare each target before its attack, each must be perceived within 60 ft/line of effect. Different legal recipients allowed; each beam is a separate hit/damage event. Ordinary critical doubles that beam’s die only. No CHA damage modifier, pushing or automatic extra effect. Normal cantrip RP 0, actual independent costs, Dissonance/Refrain and interruption apply once for the cast, not once per beam. No generic ordinary catalog access or Warlock class is inferred.
completeProfile.grant: Forbidden Pact or Eldritch Echo supplies one actual cantrip spellcasting route. Duplicate grant creates no duplicate spell, price waiver, resource pool, known-spell count or separate Refrain.
